verses.text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

segments.text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation:
Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.text: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

segments.text: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off?
Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.text: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.

segments.text: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me:
Let them bring me unto thy holy hill,

verses.text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

segments.text: Then will I go unto the altar of God,
And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

verses.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

segments.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul?
And why art thou disquieted within me?
Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him,
the help of my countenance, and my God.
